A.claim: A^3 + B^3 = C^p has no primitive nontrivial solutions for every prime p, not merely for p <= 700.

B.claim: The linear form z log C - y log B from the size window equals log(1 + A^x/B^y) identically, so it carries no information beyond the ratio of the summands and yields no new obstruction. Combining the M3 size window with the M1 congruence sieve gives a ~17x search reduction.
